documents.title: Corrigendum To The Notice Of 34Th Annual General Meeting Of Shareholders Of Premier Polyfilm Limited
Clarification Letter On Price Movement Of Our Securities
Clarification sought from Premier Polyfilm Ltd

analysis.summary: Premier Polyfilm Limited reported a robust financial performance for the fiscal year 2025-2026, with net profit surging to ₹3,188 lakhs and production volume of PVC flooring, sheeting, and allied products growing to 29,311 metric tonnes. The company secured an 18.13-acre industrial plot at SIPCOT Industrial Park where logistics and trading activities have commenced, alongside placing orders for new machinery. Furthermore, the board recommended a dividend of 15% (₹0.15 per equity share) for the financial year. This document from Premier Polyfilm Limited provides notice for its Annual General Meeting and details administrative, auditor, and managerial appointment resolutions. The text outlines specific executive appointments, remuneration terms, and board structure details for the company.

demand_outlook.claim: The company stated that its products continue to be in demand as a result of R&D cost-reduction efforts.
demand_outlook.quote: By introducing above R&D formulations has helped the company to reduce cost of new range of colour schemes and designs of finished products the Company’s products continue to be in demand.

capex_expansion.claim: The company has secured and taken possession of an 18.13-acre industrial plot at SIPCOT Industrial Park.
capex_expansion.quote: The Company has secured and taken possession of an 18.13-acre industrial plot at SIPCOT Industrial Park and that the Company has commenced logistics and trading activities at the new unit and the billing process has also started.

capex_expansion.claim: An order has been placed for the manufacturing of PVC films and paper tube manufacturing machine, with advance payment made.
capex_expansion.quote: Further, the Company has placed an order for manufacturing of PVC films and paper tube manufacturing machine and the advance payment for the same has been made.

margins_costs.claim: The company successfully implemented a dual strategy of procuring raw materials at competitive prices while maintaining stable selling prices for finished goods.
margins_costs.quote: The Company successfully implemented a dual strategy of procuring raw materials at highly competitive prices while maintaining stable selling prices for finished goods.

margins_costs.claim: Sub-optimal margin product lines were strategically discontinued to concentrate on high-demand, high-profitability categories.
margins_costs.quote: This was complemented by the strategic discontinuation of product lines with sub-optimal margins, allowing for a concentrated focus on high-demand, high-profitability categories.

margins_costs.claim: Management reported that lower profitability previously was caused by economic slowdown and adverse market conditions.
margins_costs.quote: Due to economic slowdown and consequent adverse market conditions prevailing, there was lower profitability in the Company.

margins_costs.claim: The increase in cash profit was achieved because the company arranged raw materials at cheaper rates without changing finished goods sale prices.
margins_costs.quote: The reasons for increase in cash profit during the current quarter and year ended on 31st March,2024 was mainly due to that company could arrange raw material at cheaper rate and sold the finished goods at existing sales prices i.e. the prices of finished goods were not changed/devalued.

margins_costs.claim: Production of low-profit finished goods items was stopped to improve performance.
margins_costs.quote: Secondly productions of some of the items of finished goods which were not generated good profits were stopped and to some extent company could arrange cheaper loan from other bank i.e. Yes Bank Limited and hence finance cost was also reduced.

orders_capacity.claim: Production volume of PVC flooring, sheeting, and allied products grew to 29,311 metric tonnes from 28,383 metric tonnes in the prior year.
orders_capacity.quote: Operational excellence was a key highlight, with production volume of PVC flooring, sheeting, and allied products growing to 29,311 metric tonnes from 28,383 metric tonnes in the prior year.

orders_capacity.claim: The company achieved higher capacity utilization through the installation and utilization of new plant and machinery.
orders_capacity.quote: The Company achieved higher capacity utilization with the installation and utilization of new Plant & Machinery.

capital_allocation.claim: The board recommended a dividend of 15% amounting to ₹0.15 per equity share of ₹1/- each for the financial year ended March 31, 2026.
capital_allocation.quote: The Board of your company is pleased to recommend for your approval Payment of dividend @ 0.15 per equity share of Rs.1/- each (i.e. 15%) for the year ended on 31st March,2026 subject to deduction of Tax at Source

capital_allocation.claim: An amount of ₹400/- lakh was transferred to General Reserves during the year under review.
capital_allocation.quote: During the year under review, the Board has transferred an amount of Rs. 400/- Lakh to General Reserves.

capital_allocation.claim: The Board of Directors recommended a dividend of 15% amounting to Rs. 0.75 per equity share of Rs. 5 each for the financial year 2023-2024.
capital_allocation.quote: “RESOLVED THAT a dividend of 15% (Rs.0.75 per equity share of Rs. 5/-) as recommended by the Board of Directors be and is hereby declared out of the profits of the Company for the financial year 2023-2024.”

risks_headwinds.claim: The company received a notice from the National Stock Exchange of India Limited regarding non-compliance due to a delay in uploading the XBRL Integrated Filing containing Related Party Transaction disclosures.
risks_headwinds.quote: During the year under review, the Company received a notice from the National Stock Exchange of India Limited (NSE) regarding non-compliance with the provisions of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015 (“SEBI Listing Regulations”) due to delay in uploading the Integrated Filing (XBRL) containing Related Party Transaction disclosures under Regulation 23(9) of the SEBI Listing Regulations on the NEAPS portal.

risks_headwinds.claim: NSE imposed a fine of ₹50,000/- on the company for delay in uploading the Integrated Filing.
risks_headwinds.quote: Accordingly, NSE imposed a fine of ₹50,000/- vide its order dated 16th February, 2026.

management_commitments.claim: Commercial production through the newly ordered PVC films and paper tube manufacturing machine is expected to commence in the forthcoming quarter.
management_commitments.quote: The commercial production through the said machine is expected to commence in the forthcoming quarter.

management_commitments.claim: The Board approved the re-appointment of Shri Ram Babu Verma as Executive Director for a period of twelve months effective from 27th December, 2024.
management_commitments.quote: “RESOLVED THAT pursuant to the provisions of Sections 196, 197, 203 and any other applicable provisions of the Companies Act, 2013 and the rules made thereunder (including any statutory modification(s) or re-enactment thereof for the time being in force), read with Schedule V to the Companies Act, 2013 and the Companies (Appointment and Remuneration of Managerial Personnel) Rules, 2014, and subject to such other approvals, permissions, sanctions as may be necessary and as per the provisions of Articles of Association of the Company, the consent of the Members of the Company be and is hereby accorded by way of Special Resolution to the re-appointment of Shri Ram Babu Verma (holding DIN 08760599) as a Whole-time Director of the Company designated as “Executive Director” for a period of twelve (12) months effective from 27th December, 2024.”

management_commitments.claim: The Board approved the re-appointment of Shri Amitaabh Goenka as Managing Director and CEO for a period of thirty-six months effective from 13th July, 2025.
management_commitments.quote: “RESOLVED THAT pursuant to the provisions of Sections 196, 197, 203 and any other applicable provisions of the Companies Act, 2013 and the rules made thereunder (including any statutory modification(s) or re-enactment thereof for the time being in force), read with Schedule V to the Companies Act, 2013 and the Companies (Appointment and Remuneration of Managerial Personnel) Rules, 2014, and subject to such other approvals, permissions, sanctions as may be necessary and as per the provisions of Articles of Association of the Company, the consent of the Members of the Company be and is hereby accorded by way of Special Resolution to the re-appointment of Shri Amitaabh Goenka (holding DIN 00061027) as a Whole-time Director of the Company designated as “Managing Director & CEO” for a period of thirty-six (36) months effective from 13th July, 2025.”

management_commitments.claim: The company plans to fully switch to other sustainable and renewable sources of power such as Solar and PNG energy during the current financial year.
management_commitments.quote: Seeing the Government inclination towards pollution free environment and as per various notifications of Government in this regard,your Company plans to fully switch other sustainable and renewable sources of power/energy such as Solar and PNG energy inaddition to available current source of power energy available with the company during the current financial year.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
